settings.dateFormat: not set: GnuCash's default, locale, which under C is %m/%d/%y; no check reads a date

dates.date-0: 2024-03-01 00:00:00 UTC, gnc:get-start-this-month for the pinned now (:69)

book: Three groups in one book, one per test function, each with its own environment and its own top-level "Root" (ASSET) with Asset.Bank, Asset.Wallet, Expenses (EXPENSE) and Income (INCOME), USD (:51-57); the accounts are listed above by group and full name. in-txn (:72-73): Bank +$1 from Income on date-1, Wallet +$5 from Income on date-2. out-txn (:116-120): on date-1 Bank +$100 from Income and Expenses +$1 from Bank; on date-2 Wallet +$100 from Income and Expenses +$5 from Wallet. null-txn (:165-168): in-txn's two transactions and, on date-1, Bank +$20 from Wallet.
optionValues: Options are those changed from the template's defaults; each test makes its own options object. {"absolute": "date-N"} is the time above. Accounts are given as group.full name, in the order the test gives them.
cellSelection: GnuCash reads text at HTML table positions with sxml->table-row-col (5.17:gnucash/report/test/test-report-extras.scm:96-109) after stripping <script> elements (:82-83): table 1; row 1 is the first data row (the header row holds <th> cells, which a <td> selection skips), null every row; column 1 is the date, 2 Money In, 3 Money Out, 4 Net Flow (5.17:gnucash/report/reports/standard/cashflow-barchart.scm:304-324); the last row is Total. A check with "count" expects the number of cells selected rather than their text. Checks marked "readAs": "number" read each cell with the test's str->num (:43-49): keep only digits, '-' and '.', then string->number, so "$1.00" reads 1.0; "expected" holds those numbers as GnuCash writes them, and "implied" the strings they imply under the C locale.
